messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty autopage triggered: high 5xx rate in prod-eu-west1 (last 5m). Alert: `error_rate>=5%` across /v1/generate. PD incident: INC1759987650. See: https://pd/redwood/INC1759987650 :rotating_light:

sam: acked. i'm oncall. watching metrics now.

jen: seeing same — 5xx ~9% over 5m, spike started ~1759987200. Top upstream: model-inference-v2 pool.

alex: any recent deploys? I see a canary rolled 8m ago to eu-west1.

mira: running quick check of kv-cache evictions and backend retries...

ops-bot: autoscaler reports increased queue length on inference-router-eu-1 (qlen=120 -> high), replicas=24 -> no new scale event in last 10m.

mira: logs snippet from inference-router-eu-1:``` 2024-10-18T14:32:04Z ERROR proxy: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate (connection reset) 2024-10-18T14:32:07Z WARN kvcache: eviction_count=1245 ```

alex: suggests temporary traffic diversion to prod-us-west1 for non-EU customers. can we flip route weight for route gen-v1?

sam: can do a controlled route shift of 30% -> us-west to reduce load. needs approval from oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: give me 2 mins, checking if rollback of the canary is needed. also check if customer-affecting.

jen: customer-impact: external error rates for top-10 tenants show 0/10 had user-visible errors; however we are seeing elevated client retries in APM traces. notify support if that changes.

mira: root-cause hypothesis: canary changed request batching -> increased upstream concurrency -> kvcache churn -> more backend connections -> some 502s.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) shift 30% non-EU traffic to us-west 2) warm kvcache on eu nodes by prefetch 3) optionally rollback canary if errors persist >10m. executing step 1.

ops-bot: route change applied: gen-v1 weight eu-west=70%, us-west=30% (safe-rollout).

jen: watching error rate after shift...

mira: after weight change error rate dropped from 9% -> 3.2% within 60s, kvcache eviction_rate falling.

oncall-sre: good result. keep P90 latency under review. I'll keep the PD incident assigned and monitor for 30m. if stable -> close.

alex: create follow-up ticket to harden canary validation for batching changes. filing: INT-17599877.

sam: leaving oncall for next 30m to observe. handing to oncall-sre for stabilization. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PD update: INC1759987650 -> status: in_progress -> assignee: oncall-sre. timeline and notes attached.

mira: postmortem note: possible regression in batching heuristics; will add preflight sim for kvcache pressure.

jen: no user-visible outages reported. support notified to escalate if tickets appear.

oncall-sre: closing loop after 30m if no regression. assigning follow-up owners: mira (root cause), alex (canary rollout policy), jen (customer comms).

sam: thanks team — nice quick coordination. :raised_hands:
